observations: Single automotive headlight assembly with clear lens, projector-style inner lens, reflector, and amber indicator section at bottom.
Black plastic housing and mounting brackets visible; a second black plastic car part lies beneath it.
No readable brand, model, or part number on the visible surfaces.
Seller text mentions Kia and Hyundai genuine spare parts, new and fairly used.

claims.claim: All kia and Hyundai genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used ones
claims.evidence: Seller's text only; photo shows one headlight with no brand or part number.

risks.risk: Headlight may not fit the buyer's specific Kia or Hyundai model.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the part number or label on the back of the headlight, or photo showing it mounted on the buyer's car model.

risks.risk: Lights may not work (bulbs, ballast, wiring, seals).
risks.proof: Video of the headlight powered on with low beam, high beam, and indicator functioning.

risks.risk: Lens may be cracked, cloudy, or moisture-damaged; mounting tabs may be broken.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens edges, interior, and mounting points.

risks.risk: Part may be aftermarket rather than genuine Kia/Hyundai.
risks.proof: Photo of OEM branding, part number, or original packaging.

proof_requests: Photo of the back label or part number of the headlight.
Video of the headlight switched on (low beam, high beam, indicator).
Close-up photos of the lens, mounting brackets, and interior for cracks or moisture.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a car headlight assembly from the photo, so a worst-case price can be set despite unverified function, fitment, and origin.
